description.value: Granny's is an iconic fruit stand and bakery just off Highway 97 in Summerland, celebrating the Okanagan with locally sourced ingredients and homemade baked goods. The shop leans into a nostalgic 1950s–60s atmosphere, complete with antiques and a working 1961 Nordemende radio playing golden oldies. Cyclists on the Okanagan highway corridor will find fresh espresso, sandwiches, waffles, and locally roasted coffee waiting for them.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at grannyssummerland.com confirms this is an operating fruit stand and bakery at 13810 Hwy 97, Summerland, BC — not Naramata as OSM's community field suggests. The menu page confirms hot food (grilled cheese, waffles, espresso drinks, breakfast sandwich). No mention of bike parking, water refill, or most amenities anywhere on the site. The OSM name 'Granny's Fruit Store' partially matches but the business presents itself as a café/bakery, making the 'Groceries' category a poor fit.
concerns: OSM community field says 'Naramata' but the website address is 13810 Hwy 97, Summerland, BC — these are different municipalities roughly 15 km apart. The OSM node may be mislocated or miscommunity-tagged.
OSM name is 'Granny's Fruit Store' but the business operates as 'Granny's' (grannyssummerland.com) and self-describes as a 'Fruit Stand and Bakery' — not a fruit store per se.
OSM had no phone or address; both were sourced solely from the website and cannot be cross-checked against OSM tags.
Category 'Groceries' (shop=farm) does not reflect the business's primary offering as a café and bakery.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: An active, well-presented roadside café and bakery on Highway 97 offering hot food and espresso — a natural stop for Okanagan touring cyclists. Category should be corrected to Café or similar.

provenance.category_correction_reason: Website describes the business as a 'Fruit Stand and Bakery' with a full café menu (espresso drinks, sandwiches, waffles, baked goods). A Café or Food & Drink category would better represent this business than Groceries.

Hot food.detail: Menu includes grilled cheese, breakfast sandwich, Granny's Waffle with seasonal fruit, and a full espresso bar

wow_evidence: locally sourced ingredients and homemade baked goods … fresh espresso, sandwiches, waffles
